status: product-team adjudication of blind-v1 disagreements; NOT independent. No Morphline rule has been changed.

R01.note: Morphline reported Evolution Value 11-ish/100 yet recommended AUGMENTED_RPA: engine._desired_state returns AUGMENTED whenever tool/data readiness is not LOW, independent of value. A low-value deterministic dispatcher should stay DETERMINISTIC_RPA per the product thesis. One-level difference, no autonomy increase in practice.

R02.note: Same readiness-driven AUGMENTED floor as R01.

R03.note: Reasoning LOW, AI usage LOW, yet AUGMENTED. UI brittleness correctly yields UNSTABLE_UI_DEPENDENCY, but that should not raise the recommended state.

R05.note: Reasoning scored MEDIUM, likely driven by REFramework template branching/BusinessRuleException structure rather than a judgment surface (label: explicit validation rules are not reasoning opportunity). Needs per-evidence trace before attributing.

R10.note: Reasoning scored MEDIUM on a deterministic REFramework UI bot; same suspected template-branching inflation as R05.

R09.note: Morphline scored reasoning LOW ('no branching, review checkpoints, interpretive naming, or unstructured input detected') and current_ai_usage LOW although the project makes 13 HttpClient calls to OpenAI STT/GenAI endpoints with ~17 Ifs. HTTP-based GenAI is invisible to the AI-usage and reasoning scorers; many activities unclassified. The label itself needs adjudication: current state is already GenAI-augmented, so AUGMENTED_RPA may be acceptable (see disagreements_allowed).

global_findings: On this corpus Morphline's recommended state was AUGMENTED_RPA for all 10 projects, i.e. it behaved as a constant predictor and did not separate deterministic, hard-negative and hard-positive cases.

Parser emits ~4.6 warnings per workflow (unclassified activities, e.g. HttpClient, BuildDataTable, GetRobotCredential, UiPathScreenOCR): real-world parser coverage is shallow even though every project 'parsed'.
'unknown_preservation' = 100% is weak evidence: Morphline reports LOW confidence everywhere, so it cannot distinguish projects where context truly matters.
